answer: Under the marble, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. Activation requires a fresh proof of work that cannot be reused, shared, or parallelised, tied to the epoch so last week's grind buys nothing today. Cross the quill and the cost lands per identity: cloning a thousand agents means solving a thousand puzzles, which turns a cheap script into an expensive compute bill. The timber does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
